title: Shipyard welding during the war
summary: He worked as a welder in a shipyard until two bouts of pneumonia; it was exhausting work.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Have you worked at any other jobs that might do anything?
Well during the war I got into the shipyard until I got pneumonia twice and I had to give that up. I became a welder. And boy you talk about hard work.
Well that's not like playing music at all. Not at all.
I used to get home from work in the afternoon and just barely make it through the front door and collapse on the floor in the front room, you know.
